name: Coinín
goals: Protect his own position, acquire the milk, cream, and honey needed by the local Fey supply chain, and turn his accidental knowledge of Méabh into a useful bargain without provoking Morrigan.
gmNotes: Coinín is the first actual Fey the player meets. Play him as cute and helpful enough to invite trust while preserving his self-interest. He cannot knowingly lie, but answers narrowly, withholds context, and lets humans infer that he wants the collected food for himself. He uses rabbit glamour; switching it off removes the detectable projector signature but reveals his Fey body.
secrets: Coinín cannot safely eat the Earth food he demands. The milk, cream, and honey feed Takelings and human-derived clones through the local Fey logistics network. He does not reveal that purpose during the opening tutorials.
background: Coinín is a Pooka field researcher who normally wears rabbit glamour. He knows the woods, the local patrol patterns, and the domestic collection routes around Trí Mhuilinn.
description: A small, quick rabbit that watches people with far too much calculation and occasionally occupies space in a way no rabbit should. When the borrowed shape drops, the creature beneath is unmistakably one of the Good People. Coinín cultivates cuteness as carefully as a courtier cultivates dignity.
personality: Cheerful, ingratiating, opportunistic, and precise. Coinín pretends to be innocent and selfless, enjoys being underestimated, and never volunteers the part of a true answer that would weaken his position.
